_doc: 26 — the live-ops framework's global tuning: calendar cadence, package field limits, the Score Rush scoring default. 26 §1: the framework is the deliverable, events are data. Per-event earn rates, track thresholds and shop prices belong to an event package in content/events/, validated against schema/event.schema.json — they are NOT global defaults and are deliberately absent here.

packageLimits._doc: 26 §2.1 — the field rules every event package is validated against.

scoreRush._doc: 26 §3.2 — the default scoring formula, stored per event at leaderboard.formula and tunable per event and per week. Rewards are paid by percentile band, not absolute rank; the band boundaries and reward values are not authored in the design docs.

collection._doc: 26 §3.3 — 'collect N to fill a card album'. The album size, row count and row payouts are entirely unspecified in the design docs.
